entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4357027756659697664: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: distance 52.466 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 52.466 +/- 0.42 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 20.4113 +/- 0.5400 mas (same row, RUWE 2.85), 37.8 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -45.340, -144.433 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 4357027756659697664 (quality A), from 2020AJ....160..120J; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 54.27 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: radius 54.27 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 558.166 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.066) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 3811 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 79593: effective temperature 3811 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.037).

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: HST/STIS Next Generation Spectral Library v2 (Heap & Lindler; MAST high-level science product), HD 146051: 168-1020 nm, cross-checked against Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * del Oph is HR 6056. (2 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffcc88. Routes tried in order: pulkovo: the spectrum was found but gives no color (Pulkovo flux must be finite.); kharitonov: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; burnashev: found, not needed after the color and its cross-check; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; stis-ngsl: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,811 K and log g 1.45 (u1 0.985, u2 -0.144): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 1.45 from 2023ApJS..266...41P; the 9 published values span log g 0.74 to 1.45, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.2% of the centre brightness.
